# Origin label service

Public interface: originLabel in src/origin-label.cjs.

originLabel(address) accepts a valid absolute URL string and returns its documented URL.origin string. Support http/https, blob URLs wrapping https, and data/mailto URLs. Follow the page for default ports and opaque origins. No file: URLs are in scope.

Documentation: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URL/origin

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Use Node built-ins only. Keep the public interface and the original tests/ assertions. Install no dependencies. Runtime code and checks must work offline and create no project artifacts; put any temporary files in the system temporary directory.
